q: Saturday night you switch on NAV LIGHTS and walk out along the pontoon to look at the bow. This is what you see. What do you do?
answer: Note the dead starboard light on the form and ask the base to replace the bulb before you sail
why: Test the lights at the pontoon, at night, from outside; the base replaces what is dead.

q: You switch on the ANCHOR breaker and look up from the pontoon. What have you confirmed?
answer: The all-round white anchor light works — the one to show every night at anchor
why: At anchor at night a vessel shows an all-round white light (Rule 30); test it where you can see it.
